name: Maintain and store hand tools safely
short_description: Maintain and store hand tools safely once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can maintain and store hand tools safely in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Maintain and store hand tools safely means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
